House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to Catholic Charities of St. Paul and Minneapolis for its operation of the homeless elders program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CATHOLIC CHARITIES HOMELESS ELDERS PROGRAM. +]

[+$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Catholic Charities of St. Paul and Minneapolis to operate its homeless elders program that helps homeless, isolated, and low-income older adults to move into stable housing. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to Catholic Charities of St. Paul and Minneapolis for its operation of the homeless elders program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CATHOLIC CHARITIES HOMELESS ELDERS PROGRAM.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Catholic Charities of St. Paul and Minneapolis to operate its homeless elders program that helps homeless, isolated, and low-income older adults to move into stable housing.
additions: APPROPRIATION; CATHOLIC CHARITIES HOMELESS ELDERS PROGRAM.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Catholic Charities of St. Paul and Minneapolis to operate its homeless elders program that helps homeless, isolated, and low-income older adults to move into stable housing.
